name: Palacio del Inka, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Cusco
insider_take: This isn't just a hotel—it's a living piece of Inca history where ancient stone walls from the 15th-century Inca palace of Huayna Capac seamlessly blend with colonial Spanish architecture.
whats_special: Built directly on the foundations of an authentic Inca palace, the hotel showcases original Inca stonework throughout its corridors and courtyards. Located just steps from Cusco's main plaza at 11,200 feet above sea level, it's perfectly positioned for exploring both the historic city center and serving as your gateway to Machu Picchu.
pro_tip: Arrive a day early to acclimate to the altitude—the hotel's oxygen-enriched rooms and coca tea service will help you adjust before your Machu Picchu adventure.
dont_miss: The hotel's underground Inca museum displays artifacts discovered during construction, and the courtyard's ancient stone walls are illuminated at night for a magical atmosphere. Book the Inca Rail's First Class service to Machu Picchu—the hotel can arrange exclusive packages with priority booking.
pros: Prime location in historic Cusco city center near Plaza de Armas
Beautifully preserved colonial architecture with Inca stone foundations
Luxurious amenities and world-class service standards
Ideal base for exploring Machu Picchu and Sacred Valley
cons: High altitude location at 11,200 feet may cause adjustment issues
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
